claude_proposed_widenings.name: DenyOpportunityAttackEffect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The on-hit rider 'can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn' maps to the v4 atom deny_opportunity_attack, but the Effect union in types.ts is restricted to DamageEffect | NoneEffect. The atom exists in v4 taxonomy but is absent from the surface type.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Lightning damage, and it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: onHit multi-effect composite
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Shocking Grasp delivers two simultaneous on-hit effects: damage and deny_opportunity_attack. The current ActivationPhase has onHit: Effect (single). A composite form (e.g., onHit: ReadonlyArray<Effect>) is needed to represent spells with multiple co-occurring on-hit effects.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Lightning damage, and it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.
